rotation_note: Unattended-run override: NO rotating subset. All 3 core keywords plus the entire politics pool (34 keywords, grouped into elections_public_opinion / geopolitics / policy_regulation) are working keywords today (37 total). Day-of-year 318 sets ORDER only: group lead rotates so no group leads twice in a row (geopolitics led 11-12, policy_regulation led 11-13, so elections_public_opinion leads today, then geopolitics, then policy_regulation); within each group the list starts at offset 318 % group_size in pool order (elections 9 -> 3: AI disinformation first; geopolitics 10 -> 8: AI 패권 first; policy 15 -> 3: AI liability first). Queries were not checked with WebSearch (budget reserved for librarians); librarians should prefer outlet RSS/sitemap_news feeds over site: search for recency. Window: last brief was 2026-11-13, so items published 11-13 (after the prior harvest) through 11-14 are in scope. Context: Saturday 11-14 in Korea / Friday 11-13 in the US and EU at harvest time; weekend means thinner official output — Friday-evening US releases (agency notices, court orders, Federal Register public-inspection items for Monday) and Korean Saturday wire copy matter most. The Dublin informal European Council on AI met Friday 11-13 — an adopted declaration/leaders' statement text or Commission package released 11-13 IS now new; previews, member-state letters and reaction pieces are not. Korea: 수능 was 11-12 — an actual AI/smart-glasses cheating incident with official 교육부/평가원/경찰 action is new; screening-measure previews are not. Also 과기정통부, 개인정보위 (Anthropic probe — only findings/sanction), 국회 예산 심사·과방위 법안소위. US Friday 11-13: lame-duck Congress (NDAA AI provisions, chip-security bills), BIS (7-country license rule was reported 11-13 via The Information — only the published rule text in the Federal Register/BIS site is new), court dockets (San Francisco Superior Court suit vs five AI labs covered 11-13 — only a hearing, TRO ruling or company filing is new), state AGs. Upcoming hooks (only official documents are new, skip previews): CCW 7th Review Conference Geneva 11-16..20; APEC Shenzhen US-China summit 11-18..19; House closed briefing with Jensen Huang 11-18; Meta AI-scraping terms take effect 11-20; Delhi HC Kriti Sanon hearing 12-10. In scope: bills introduced/marked up, agency rules/bulletins, court rulings and filings, regulator enforcement, export-control actions, official after-action reports on AI-enabled interference, platform takedown reports. OUT of scope: who won, seat counts, polling, horse-race analysis, commentary without a new document. Neutrality rule from sources.json applies: report decisions/filings/releases, attribute contested claims, no partisan framing.
